concerns.text: The plan cites a generic OpenNeuro‑Parquet dataset (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/clane9/openneuro-fslr64k/...`) as the primary source of fMRI data, but this dataset does not contain the required improvisation vs. scripted task labels (FR‑001). The specification explicitly demands a dataset with musical improvisation tasks (e.g., OpenNeuro ds000246 or ds001600). Using a dataset that lacks the necessary experimental condition makes it impossible to test the core hypothesis, violating the functional requirement and rendering the analysis infeasible.
